format: audio/ref/<key>.mp3 for the referee, audio/av/<folder>/<key>.mp3 for each avatar (folder = avatar index 00..56: boys 00-27, girls 28-55, Robo 56; within a gender the order is look-major: brunette, blonde, ginger, native, asian, poly, indian, each as kid, young adult, forties, grandparent)

referee.voice_hint: stadium announcer / referee, big and clear

lines.wrong: Not quite.
lines.qb: Quarterback, pick who gets the ball. Defense, no peeking!
lines.captain: Captain, guess who gets the ball.
lines.ot: Tied up! Overtime. Next score wins.

avatar_keys.block: makes the block, pick or tackle on defense
